$comment: Exceptions to the cache's own answer, applied by AnimationStalls.plugin.js. Core measures every swing from its seq config (NpcAnimationScanner.getSequenceStall). A seq that withholds steps is a partial stall and needs no row - hunters' crossbows (seq 4230), the polearm, salamander, chinchompa, obby-ring, banner, partisan and bulwark styles, and the standard cast animations (711 and friends) all do. Rows are for full stalls the config cannot express. They override the measured value by animation id or by equipped weapon id: kind none|partial|full, ticks (omit to keep the cache's length), holdsHits. Cite the source for every row.

20727.source: Wiki: Animation stall - Attack animation stalls. Its battleaxe seqs (395, 401) carry masks, so the client does not withhold steps for them and the cache rates the swing free; live still locks the player for the animation.
